reviewNote: Provisional reading of official 18-page advertisement Table I and 10-page exam instructions. First connector output, reservation rows and post-specific qualifications require founder review; no closing clock hour is printed.

posts.title: Accountant
posts.qualifications: Graduate and CA/ICWA Intermediate pass; three years of relevant accounts experience after that Intermediate qualification. Basic computer and SAP-FICO proficiency are desirable. All six vacancies are backlog/reserved.

posts.title: Technician (Survey)
posts.qualifications: ITI in Survey or Diploma in Survey. One year of post-qualification survey experience is desirable, not mandatory. Six fresh and six backlog posts.

posts.title: Technician (Sampling)
posts.qualifications: B.Sc.; one year of post-qualification Drill Core or Mine Sampling experience is desirable. Six fresh and one backlog post.

posts.title: Technician (Laboratory)
posts.qualifications: B.Sc. in Chemistry, Physics or Geology. One year of relevant laboratory experience is desirable. Both posts are backlog and marked for ex-servicemen.

posts.title: Assistant (Materials)
posts.qualifications: Graduate with Mathematics or B.Com.; approved/recognized course and degree. No mandatory experience. Basic computer and SAP-MM skills are desirable. Six fresh and ten backlog posts.

posts.title: Assistant (Accounts)
posts.qualifications: B.Com. from approved/recognized course. No mandatory experience. Basic computer and SAP-FICO skills are desirable. Five fresh and five backlog posts.

posts.title: Stenographer (English)
posts.qualifications: Graduate in any stream plus English shorthand certificate at 80 words per minute. Basic computer skill is desirable. All four vacancies are backlog; verify category and ex-serviceman/PwD allocation.

posts.title: Assistant (Hindi)
posts.qualifications: Graduate with Hindi and English as subjects, or degree in English plus an equivalent examination in Advanced Hindi. Basic computer proficiency with Hindi is desirable. One SC backlog vacancy.

posts.title: Electrician
posts.qualifications: ITI or Diploma in Electrical, valid Wireman certificate, and one year of post-certificate electrical work experience. Six fresh and one backlog post; medical colour/night-vision check applies.

posts.title: Machinist
posts.qualifications: ITI in Turner/Machinist/Grinder/Miller trade or specified mechanical/manufacturing/production/tool-and-die Diploma, plus one year of relevant machine-shop experience. Both posts are ST backlog; medical colour/night-vision check applies.

posts.title: Technician (Drilling)
posts.qualifications: Specified mechanic/fitter ITI or Drilling/Mechanical Engineering Diploma, valid HMV licence, and one year of qualifying drilling or rig-maintenance experience after ITI where applicable. All twelve posts are backlog/reserved for ex-servicemen; medical vision check applies.

posts.title: Mechanic
posts.qualifications: Specified Diesel/Motor Mechanic/Fitter ITI or mechanical/automobile/production/manufacturing Diploma, valid HMV licence, and one year relevant post-qualification mechanic experience. Apprenticeship may count under notice conditions. One OBC-NCL backlog post; medical vision check applies.

posts.title: Mechanic-cum-Operator (Drilling)
posts.qualifications: Specified earth-moving/diesel/motor mechanic/fitter ITI or Mechanical/Automobile/Drilling Engineering Diploma, plus one year of relevant post-ITI mechanic, fitter or drilling experience. Apprenticeship may count under notice conditions. Twenty-four fresh and six backlog posts; medical vision check applies.

posts.title: Junior Driver
posts.qualifications: 10th pass, valid LMV and HMV licences, and one year combined light/heavy vehicle driving experience. Five fresh and one backlog post; medical vision check applies.

posts.title: Assistant (IT)
posts.qualifications: Listed computer-related bachelor's degree, or any graduation plus one-year post-graduation or PG Diploma in IT/Computer Science/Computer Applications from recognized institution. No mandatory experience. Three fresh posts.

posts.title: Assistant (HR)
posts.qualifications: BA, B.Com., B.Sc., BBA, BBM or BSW from approved/recognized institution. No mandatory experience. Basic computer and SAP-HCM proficiency are desirable. Two fresh and one backlog post.
